payout_quote: This offer is limited to a new Associated Bank business checking account opened and funded through October 31, 2026. Open a Business Access Checking account and receive a $100 bonus ... OR ... a Business Balanced Checking account and receive a $400 bonus ... OR ... a Business Choice Checking account and receive a $750 bonus ... with a minimum deposit of $2,000 / $5,000 / $20,000 in new money within 30 days of account opening ... must maintain a minimum daily balance ... between days 31 to 90 after opening your account.
steps: Open a new Associated Bank business checking account (Business Access, Balanced, or Choice) with a $100 minimum opening deposit, opened and funded through October 31, 2026.
Deposit $2,000 (Access, $100 bonus), $5,000 (Balanced, $400 bonus), or $20,000 (Choice, $750 bonus) in new money from outside Associated Bank within 30 days of account opening.
Maintain at least that minimum daily balance between days 31 and 90 after opening.
Bonus is deposited into the new business checking account within 120 days of account opening; account must be open at payout and remain open for a minimum of 12 months.
catches: New money only: funds from outside Associated Bank; deposits or transfers from existing Associated accounts do not qualify.

12-month account-open commitment: 'If the account is closed within 12 months, Associated Bank reserves the right to deduct the monetary bonus from the account prior to closing' — an early-closure clawback.
Bonus paid up to 120 days after account opening (slow payout).

Balanced and Choice accounts carry $20 and $35 monthly maintenance fees respectively unless waived (Balanced: $5,000 average monthly balance; Choice: $15,000 combined balance); fee drag reduces net bonus if not waived.
Offer limited to new business checking accounts opened and funded through 10/31/2026; subject to cancellation without notice.
Bonus is taxable income (standard bank-bonus 1099 treatment).
biggest_catch: A 12-month early-closure clawback: close the account within a year and Associated Bank can deduct the bonus back. The $750 tier requires parking $20,000 for 90 days and the bonus may take up to 120 days to arrive. Offer expires 10/31/2026.
eligibility: New Associated Bank business checking customers only; new money from outside the bank required.
timing: Open and fund by 10/31/2026; deposit new money within 30 days; maintain daily balance days 31-90; bonus deposited within 120 days of account opening; keep account open 12 months.
